ai.title: Smart assistant
ai.slogan: Iraq's first agent system with a smart assistant
ai.ask_hint_card: Ask about any feature or error — the assistant explains and guides
ai.disclaimer: AI-generated answers can be wrong — double-check before any money operation. The assistant only explains; it never performs an action
ai.empty_title: Ask me anything about the app
ai.empty_hint: How to do something, or what a message means — answered for your company and permissions
ai.report_a11y: Report a wrong or inappropriate answer
ai.feedback_failed: Your feedback didn't go through — try again
ai.consent_lead: The assistant runs on AI from an outside provider, Anthropic. To answer you, our server sends it:
ai.consent_sends: The error you saw (with its general details) or your questions in the chat, with your company type and name, your role, permissions and plan, the screen and platform — after we try to hide names, usernames, phone numbers and passwords.
ai.consent_names: Hiding is best effort, not a guarantee — so don't type names, phone numbers or passwords in your question.
ai.consent_may_err: AI answers can be wrong — double-check before any money operation. The assistant never performs an action.
ai.consent_keep: We keep a masked copy, linked to your account, of what is sent (the error or the chat), with the answer, for 24 hours — up to 30 days if the assistant couldn't answer, you tap “Wrong answer”, or our automatic check finds a problem. Then it is deleted automatically. It is not included in backups, and a copy may stay in the database's technical logs for up to 30 days after deletion.
ai.consent_review: To make sure answers are accurate, we may send them back to the same provider for an automatic check. No one but our team can see them.
ai.err_nothing: There is no error to explain
ai.err_network: Couldn't reach the assistant — try again
ai.err_off: The assistant is not available right now
ai.err_no_answer: Couldn't get an answer — try again
ai.err_rate: Too many questions too fast — wait a minute and ask again
ai.err_forbidden: The assistant is not available to you right now
ai.err_server: The assistant is not available right now — try again shortly

Your MyServices Pro account will be permanently deleted, together with:
• The links between your companies and this account
• The devices registered to the account
• The remaining usage time on the account

Your internet company's data is not deleted: the SAS system, its subscribers and their records stay with the company.

You will be signed out on this device, and this cannot be undone.
